title: User Login
description: Allows users to log into the system using their credentials. It also provides options for new users to sign up and existing users to recover their password.

steps.value: User navigates to the application's entry point.
The system displays the login page with input fields for email/username and password, along with buttons for 'Login', 'Forgot Password', and 'Sign Up'.
User enters their email/username and password.
User clicks the 'Login' button.
If login is successful, the system checks the user's assigned roles.
subitems: If the user has a single role, they are redirected to the landing page for that specific role.
If the user has multiple roles, a 'roleSelection' screen is displayed, allowing the user to choose a role for the current session.

steps.value: If login fails due to incorrect credentials, an error message is displayed on the login page.

title: New User Registration
description: Enables new users to create an account and select their initial role, specifically 'patient' as per the system's onboarding rules.

steps.value: User clicks the 'Sign Up' button on the login page.
The system displays the registration form, requesting details such as name, email, password, and confirmation of password.
The form also includes a dropdown for role selection, with 'patient' as the only selectable option for new sign-ups.
User fills in all required personal details and selects 'patient' as their role.
User clicks the 'Register' or 'Sign Up' button.
The system processes the registration and sends a verification email to the provided email address.
A confirmation message is displayed, instructing the user to check their email (including spam folder) to verify their account.

title: Password Recovery Request
description: Allows users who have forgotten their password to request a password reset link via their registered email.

steps.value: User clicks the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page.
The system displays a page or modal prompting the user to enter their registered email address.
User enters their email address into the designated field.
User clicks the 'Send Reset Link' or 'Submit' button.
The system sends a password reset email to the provided address.
A confirmation message is displayed, informing the user that a password reset link has been sent to their email.

title: Password Reset
description: Enables a user to set a new password after successfully initiating the password recovery process and receiving a reset link.

steps.value: User receives a password reset email and clicks on the provided unique reset link.
The system validates the reset link and displays a password reset form with fields for 'New Password' and 'Confirm New Password'.
User enters their desired new password in both fields, ensuring they match.
User clicks the 'Set New Password' or 'Reset Password' button.
If the password reset is successful, the system confirms the change and redirects the user to the login page.
If the reset link is invalid or expired, an appropriate error message is displayed.

title: Admin Dashboard Overview
description: Provides administrators with a high-level overview of system activity, key metrics, and quick access to administrative functions.

steps.value: Login leads to the Admin Dashboard.
View summary statistics for users (total, active, new registrations).
View summary statistics for appointments (total, scheduled, completed, cancelled).
View system health indicators or recent activity logs.
Access navigation links to other administrative sections like User Management, System Configuration, or Reports.

title: Manage User Accounts
description: Allows administrators to create, view, edit, and deactivate user accounts (patients and doctors) and manage their roles.

steps.value: Navigate to the User Management section from the Admin Dashboard.
View a list of all registered users.
Search or filter users by name, email, role, or status.
Select an existing user to view their profile details.
Edit a user's personal information, assigned roles, or account status (e.g., activate, deactivate).
Save changes to the user's profile.
Initiate the creation of a new user account (e.g., for a new doctor).
Enter new user details, including name, email, and assign initial roles (e.g., 'doctor').
Submit to create the new user account.

title: Configure System Settings
description: Enables administrators to manage hospital-wide operational settings, such as operating hours, holidays, and general policies.

steps.value: Navigate to the System Configuration section from the Admin Dashboard.
View current system settings, categorized by type (e.g., General, Appointments, Policies).
Select a setting to modify (e.g., hospital operating hours, list of public holidays).
Update the value of the selected setting.
Save the changes to apply the new configuration.
Add a new configurable policy or setting.
Remove an existing configurable policy or setting.

title: Generate and Export Reports
description: Allows administrators to generate various reports on system activities and export them for further analysis or record-keeping.

steps.value: Navigate to the Reporting section from the Admin Dashboard.
Select the desired report type (e.g., Appointment Activity, User Engagement, Communication Metrics).
Specify report parameters such as date range, specific doctors, or patient groups.
Click "Generate Report" to view a preview or summary.
Select an export format (e.g., CSV, PDF).
Click "Export" to download the generated report.

title: Manage Consent Policies
description: Allows administrators to define, update, and manage the various consent policies that patients must agree to.

steps.value: Navigate to the Consent Management section.
View a list of all active and inactive consent policies.
Select an existing policy to view its details and version history.
Edit the content or terms of an existing policy.
Create a new consent policy, defining its title, description, and effective date.
Publish a new policy or update an existing one to make it active for patients.
Deactivate or archive an outdated policy.

title: Process Patient Data Rights Requests
description: Enables administrators to handle patient requests related to their data rights, such as access, correction, or deletion, in compliance with regulations.

steps.value: Navigate to the Patient Data Requests queue.
View a list of pending data access, correction, or deletion requests from patients.
Select a specific request to view its details, including the patient's identity and the nature of the request.
Review the request and gather necessary information or perform required actions (e.g., retrieve medical records for access request, initiate data correction workflow, prepare data for deletion).
Communicate with the patient regarding the status or completion of their request.
Mark the request as processed or completed.

title: View PHI Audit Logs
description: Allows administrators to review detailed audit logs for all access and modification events related to Protected Health Information (PHI) for compliance and security monitoring.

steps.value: Navigate to the Audit Logs section.
Select to view logs specifically related to PHI access and modification.
Filter audit logs by date range, user, action type (read, modify), patient, or specific PHI entity.
View detailed entries, including timestamp, user ID, action performed, affected data, and outcome.
Export filtered audit logs for external review or archiving.

title: Oversee Appointment Activity
description: Provides administrators with a comprehensive view of all appointments within the system, allowing for monitoring and oversight.

steps.value: Navigate to the Appointment Overview section from the Admin Dashboard.
View a calendar or list displaying all scheduled, pending, and completed appointments.
Filter appointments by date, doctor, patient, status (e.g., confirmed, cancelled, pending).
Select an appointment to view its detailed information (patient, doctor, time, reason).
Identify and address any scheduling conflicts or issues.

title: Patient Dashboard Overview
description: Provides patients with a personalized overview of their upcoming appointments, recent medical activities, and quick access to key features.

steps.value: Login leads to the Patient Dashboard.
View a summary of upcoming appointments.
View recent messages from doctors.
View quick links to schedule new appointments, access medical records, or message a doctor.
View notifications or alerts (e.g., new visit summary available, appointment reminder).

title: Schedule a New Appointment
description: Allows patients to search for doctors, view their availability, and request or schedule new appointments.

steps.value: From the Patient Dashboard, click on 'Schedule Appointment' or similar.
Search for a doctor by name, specialty, or department.
View a list of available doctors matching the criteria.
Select a doctor to view their detailed profile and availability calendar.
Choose a preferred date and time slot from the doctor's available schedule.
Provide the reason for the visit.
Review appointment details and confirm the booking.
Receive a confirmation of the scheduled appointment.

title: View and Manage Existing Appointments
description: Allows patients to view their scheduled appointments, check their status, and reschedule or cancel them.

steps.value: From the Patient Dashboard, click on 'My Appointments' or similar.
View a list of all past, current, and upcoming appointments.
Filter appointments by status (e.g., upcoming, completed, cancelled) or date range.
Select an individual appointment to view its detailed information (doctor, date, time, reason, status).
If the appointment is upcoming and eligible, click 'Reschedule' to select a new date/time.
If the appointment is upcoming and eligible, click 'Cancel' and provide a reason for cancellation.
Receive confirmation for rescheduling or cancellation.

title: Access Medical Records and Visit Summaries
description: Enables patients to securely view their personal medical records, including diagnoses, treatments, medications, and visit summaries.

steps.value: From the Patient Dashboard, click on 'Medical Records' or similar.
View a categorized list of medical records (e.g., Visit Summaries, Lab Results, Prescriptions, Immunizations).
Filter records by date, doctor, or type.
Select a specific record (e.g., a visit summary) to view its detailed content.
Optionally, download or print the medical record.

title: Send Secure Message to Doctor
description: Allows patients to send secure, confidential messages to their assigned doctors.

steps.value: From the Patient Dashboard, click on 'Message Doctor' or navigate to the 'Messages' section.
Select the doctor they wish to message from a list of their assigned doctors.
Compose a new message in a secure messaging interface.
Attach relevant files or images if necessary.
Click 'Send' to transmit the message.
Receive a confirmation that the message has been sent.

title: View Secure Messages
description: Allows patients to view their message history with doctors and respond to messages.

steps.value: From the Patient Dashboard, click on 'Messages' or similar.
View a list of active message conversations with different doctors.
Select a conversation to view the full message history.
Read new and unread messages.
Compose a reply within an existing conversation.
Click 'Send' to transmit the reply.

title: Manage Consent Policies
description: Allows patients to review and manage their consent for various hospital policies and data usage.

steps.value: Navigate to the 'Consent Management' or 'Privacy Settings' section.
View a list of all consent policies (e.g., data usage, treatment consent, communication preferences).
For each policy, view its current status (granted/revoked) and the date of last action.
Select a policy to view its full terms and conditions.
Click 'Grant Consent' or 'Revoke Consent' for a specific policy.
Confirm the consent action.

title: Request Data Rights (Access, Correction, Deletion)
description: Enables patients to submit requests for accessing, correcting, or deleting their personal health data in compliance with data protection laws.

steps.value: Navigate to the 'Data Rights' or 'Privacy Requests' section.
Select the type of request: 'Access My Data', 'Correct My Data', or 'Delete My Data'.
Fill out a request form, providing necessary details and justification for the request.
Attach supporting documents if required.
Submit the request.
View a history or status of submitted data rights requests.

title: Doctor Dashboard Overview
description: Provides doctors with a personalized overview of their clinical schedule, pending appointment requests, and quick access to patient records and messaging.

steps.value: Login leads to the Doctor Dashboard.
View a summary of upcoming appointments for the day or week.
View a list of pending patient appointment requests.
View recent messages from patients.
Access quick links to manage schedule, view patient records, or initiate new messages.

title: Manage Doctor's Availability
description: Allows doctors to define and update their clinical availability, including working hours, breaks, and days off.

steps.value: Navigate to the 'My Schedule' or 'Availability Management' section from the Doctor Dashboard.
View a calendar displaying current availability and scheduled appointments.
Select a date or time slot to add new availability.
Define start and end times for availability or block out a period for a break/day off.
Set recurring availability patterns (e.g., every Monday, Wednesday, Friday).
Save changes to the schedule.

title: View Scheduled Appointments
description: Enables doctors to view a comprehensive list of all their scheduled appointments, including past, current, and future.

steps.value: Navigate to the 'My Appointments' section from the Doctor Dashboard.
View a list or calendar of all scheduled appointments.
Filter appointments by date range, patient name, or status (e.g., confirmed, completed, cancelled).
Select an appointment to view detailed information, including patient details, reason for visit, and appointment status.
Optionally, launch into a virtual consultation if the appointment is scheduled for one.

title: Manage Patient Appointment Requests
description: Allows doctors to review, approve, decline, or suggest alternative times for pending appointment requests from patients.

steps.value: Navigate to the 'Appointment Requests' section from the Doctor Dashboard.
View a list of all pending appointment requests from patients.
Select a specific request to view patient details, requested date/time, and reason for visit.
Choose to 'Approve' the request, confirming the appointment.
Choose to 'Decline' the request, providing a reason.
Choose to 'Suggest Alternative Time', providing new date/time options to the patient.
Confirm the action, which notifies the patient.

title: View Patient Medical Records
description: Enables doctors to securely access and review the medical records of their assigned patients.

steps.value: Navigate to the 'Patient Records' section or click on a patient's name from an appointment or message.
Search for a specific patient by name or ID.
Select a patient from the search results to view their medical record.
View a categorized list of medical information (e.g., Visit Summaries, Diagnoses, Medications, Lab Results, Immunizations).
Filter records by date, record type, or specific criteria.
Select a specific record entry to view its detailed content.
Optionally, generate a concise summary of the patient's medical history using the 'medicalRecordSummarizer' tool.

title: Update Patient Medical Records
description: Allows doctors to add new entries or update existing information within a patient's medical record.

steps.value: From the 'View Patient Medical Records' scenario, select the patient whose record needs updating.
Click 'Add New Entry' or 'Edit' an existing entry.
Select the type of record to add (e.g., Visit Note, Diagnosis, Prescription, Lab Order).
Enter the relevant information into the form fields.
Attach supporting documents or images if necessary.
Review the entered information and click 'Save' or 'Submit'.
Receive confirmation that the medical record has been updated.

title: Send Secure Message to Patient
description: Enables doctors to initiate and send secure, confidential messages to their assigned patients.

steps.value: Navigate to the 'Messages' section or click 'Message Patient' from a patient's profile/appointment.
Select the patient they wish to message from a list of their assigned patients.
Compose a new message in a secure messaging interface.
Attach relevant files or images if necessary.
Click 'Send' to transmit the message.
Receive a confirmation that the message has been sent.

title: View Secure Messages with Patients
description: Allows doctors to view their message history with patients and respond to ongoing conversations.

steps.value: Navigate to the 'Messages' section from the Doctor Dashboard.
View a list of active message conversations with different patients.
Select a conversation to view the full message history.
Read new and unread messages.
Compose a reply within an existing conversation.
Click 'Send' to transmit the reply.

title: Role Selection
description: Allows a user with multiple assigned application roles to select which role they want to operate under for the current session after successful login.

steps.value: Login leads to Role Selection scenario if the user has multiple roles.
The system displays a list of available application roles (e.g., Patient, Doctor) assigned to the user.
User selects one of the roles from the list.
User clicks 'Continue' or 'Select Role'.
The system redirects the user to the landing page corresponding to the selected role.
